plugin.name: Meow Meow Bump Battle
plugin.description: A catgirl swimming-ring physics playground with pull-to-launch controls, water drag and bounce tuning.
ui.canvas: Swimming-ring pool. Pull a ring back and release to launch.
ui.hint: Pull a ring back and release. Try again once everything stops.
ui.tuningHint: Adjust while still. Reloading restores the defaults.
ui.placeholder: Three cats, three passive skills. Art and balance are still being refined.
state.idle: Pick a cat and try a shot
state.aiming: Release to launch · Esc to cancel
state.moving: Gliding — wait until the rings stop
state.error: Motion error. Please reset the pool.
note.free: Try a different angle and see where the rings go.
note.wall: Try straight and diagonal shots against the wall.
note.duel: Try a direct hit, then a glancing hit.
note.chain: Launch Juzi to the right and watch motion pass along.
note.corner: Aim into the corner to check crowded collisions.
